title: The existing locally constant ring Hom equivalence
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring in universe $u$ and $S$ a profinite space, meaning compact Hausdorff and totally disconnected. Use [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Write $\operatorname{LC}(S,\mathbf Z)$ for the ring of locally constant integer-valued functions. The existing canonical equivalence identifies continuous maps $\pi_0(\operatorname{Spec}R)\to S$ with unital ring homomorphisms $\operatorname{LC}(S,\mathbf Z)\to R$. It sends a continuous function to the ring homomorphism obtained by gluing the integer values along its finite clopen partitions. Its inverse sends $\varphi$ to the factor through connected components of the first coordinate of $\operatorname{Spec}(\varphi)$ under the homeomorphism in [lem-weil-pbc-locally-constant-prime-spectrum]. This is the already proved definition profiniteLocallyConstantHomEquiv, not a new construction or proof obligation.

private noncomputable def profiniteLocallyConstantHomEquiv
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}ᵒᵖ) (S : Profinite.{u}) :
    (Profinite.of (ConnectedComponents (PrimeSpectrum R.unop)) ⟶ S) ≃
      (R ⟶ profiniteToCommRingCatOp.obj S)
